_comment: Weekly input for the WBR agent. Every section is optional. Anything you omit is carried forward unchanged from the prior week's deck. Dates accept ISO (2026-08-31) or M/D/YYYY (8/31/2026). Program keys must match the keys in wbr_config.json.
_prior_deck_note: Leave blank to use baseline_deck from wbr_config.json, or set to a filename in deck_dir / an absolute path to roll a specific deck forward.

programs._comment: Per program: set rag to one of ON TRACK / AT RISK / OFF TRACK / WATCH, and body to the full card text (use \n between lines). Omit a field to keep last week's.

risks._comment: Provide the COMPLETE risk register for slide 4 (trailing rows are cleared). Omit this section to keep last week's table. severity = H / M / L.

priorities._comment: Slide 2 ranked list. Provide the full ordered list (trailing rows cleared). Omit to keep last week's.

timeline._comment: Slide 5. updated sets the 'Updated M/D/YYYY' stamp; phases optionally replace phase text by key.

reporting._comment: Slide 8. exec_summary is the one-line summary; deliverables map name + body for the two columns. Use bold headers (Accomplishments, In Progress, Risks / Blockers, Next Steps) and 'Label: text' lines for emphasis.

metrics._comment: Slide 9 support metrics. Provide current + prior week values and an insights paragraph. Omit to keep last week's.
